samples.question: Each colored mini-histogram has five equal-width bins and the same total bar height. Treat each bar's height as weight at its left-to-right bin position. For each color, compute the weighted-average bin position and compare it with the position of that color's tallest bar. Which color's weighted average lies farthest to the right of its tallest bar? Answer red, blue, green, or orange.
